description:
Calculation, not advice. Verify with a professional before acting.

Returns metadata about the running Senaro MCP server: version, contract version,
build commit, build timestamp, and the full list of supported tools.
Call this once per session before drafting any content to verify the running
process is not stale after a deploy. Idempotent, no side effects, < 50 ms.
If server_version is below the minimum required by your skill, STOP and ask
the user to restart Claude Desktop.
name: server_info
title: Senaro Server Info
